devdoc.author: [Zharta](https://zharta.io/)
devdoc.details: This is the implementation contract for each vault, which is deployed as a minimal proxy (ERC1167) by `RentingV3.vy` and accepts only calls from it. This contract holds the assets (NFTs) ) but does not store any information regarding the token, so pre-conditions must be validated by the caller (`RentingV3.vy`). It implement the functions required for token delegation and staking. Delegations are performed by warm.xyz HotWalletProxy.

__init__(address,address,address).details: Sets up the contract by initializing the payment token, NFT contract, delegation registry and staking contract addresses.

params._delegation_registry_addr: The address of the delegation registry contract.
params._nft_contract_addr: The address of the NFT contract.
params._payment_token_addr: The address of the payment token contract.

delegate_to_wallet(address,uint256).details: Delegates the NFT to the given address.

params.delegate: The address to delegate the NFT to.
params.expiration: The expiration timestamp for the delegation.

deposit(uint256,address,address).details: Transfers the NFT from the owner to the vault and optionally sets up delegation.

params.delegate: The address to delegate the NFT to. If empty no delegation is done.
params.nft_owner: The address of the NFT owner.
params.token_id: The id of the NFT to be deposited.

initialise().details: Ensures that the vault is not already initialized.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.details: Returns the ERC721 receiver callback selector.

params._data: Additional data with no specified format.
params._from: The address which previously owned the token.
params._tokenId: The NFT identifier which is being transferred.

params.pool_method_id: The method id of the staking pool claim function.
params.staking_addr: The address of the staking contract.
params.token_id: The id of the NFT supporting the claim, which must be deposited in the vault.
params.wallet: The address of the wallet to receive the staking rewards.

staking_compound(uint256,address,bytes4,.details: Compounds the staking rewards by claiming and depositing them. No validations are performed regarding staking limits or minimal deposit amounts.

params.pool_claim_method_id: The method id of the staking pool claim function.
params.pool_deposit_method_id: The method id of the staking pool deposit function.
params.staking_addr: The address of the staking contract.
params.token_id: The id of the NFT supporting the compound, which must be deposited in the vault.

staking_deposit(address,uint256,uint256,.details: Deposits the payment token into the staking contract.

params.amount: The amount of the payment token to deposit.
params.pool_method_id: The method id of the staking pool deposit function.
params.sender: The address of the payment token sender.
params.staking_addr: The address of the staking contract.
params.token_id: The id of the NFT supporting the deposit, which must be deposited in the vault.

staking_withdraw(address,uint256,uint256.details: Withdraws the payment token from the staking contract.

params.amount: The amount of the payment token to withdraw.
params.pool_method_id: The method id of the staking pool withdraw function.
params.staking_addr: The address of the staking contract.
params.token_id: The id of the NFT supporting the withdrawal, which must be deposited in the vault.
params.wallet: The address of the wallet to receive the payment token.

withdraw(uint256,address).details: Transfers the NFT from the vault to the wallet and clears the delegation.

params.token_id: The id of the NFT to be withdrawn.
params.wallet: The address of the wallet to receive the NFT.
